ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio featuring approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels and 15% low-intensity black pixels localized primarily at the margins and central notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central lobes are characterized by contiguous high-intensity white zones. Low-intensity black pixels form a continuous border along the trailing edge, with higher density clusters at the distal tips. Scattered vertical low-intensity streaks are present across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 45-50 degrees relative to the horizontal axis of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations (jagged peaks) are continuous across the entire trailing edge boundary, with most extreme variations located at the distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve originating at the peduncle, transitioning to a convex outward sweep towards the tips, terminating in a downward-curving distal point.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Rough, high-contrast black textured clusters are visible at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, corresponding to the serrated trailing edge peaks.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical, unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) are visible on the interior white surface of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy irregular serration along the trailing edge boundary suggests significant previous physical wear or trauma; a prominent dark vertical mark is located immediately to the left of the median notch.
